title: MAID expansion media framing — content-audit seed (CBC + peer literature)
legal_standard: SEED only. Full ratio sample (disability-rights vs government spokespeople 2020–2024 on CBC digital) still requires systematic article corpus. This lap freezes public secondary literature + recent CBC pieces as anchors.

thesis_link.5gw_step: Framing power → consent for hard policies (tax_dollar_to_harm_chain step 3–5)

facts_public.claim: Health Canada annual MAID reports document large and rising death totals (site corpus cites 19,660 in 2023 class; cumulative 77k+ through 2024 class in 5gw-subversion).
Bill C-7 expanded eligibility beyond reasonably foreseeable natural death (Track 2) — disability community criticism is on-record in academic and advocacy literature.

Peer-reviewed media review (Brassolotto et al. / PMC) finds Canadian news discourse shifted from 'should we permit' to 'how do we provide', with increased attention to disability vulnerability after C-7 — citing CBC Radio pieces among others.

CBC News (2026-06-16 class) covered parliamentary committee recommendation against MAID mental-illness expansion and Inclusion Canada Charter-challenge framing that Track 2 singles out people with disabilities.
UN CRPD Committee experts (Mar 2025) publicly questioned Canada on persons with disabilities seeking MAID due to unmet needs / poverty — 'state-sanctioned euthanasia' framing in expert questions.
Dying With Dignity Canada is a persistent pro-expansion / access voice in CBC and social discourse (counter-node to disability-rights critics).

framing_hypotheses.hypothesis: CBC digital MAID coverage often pairs autonomy/compassion frames with policy-process coverage; disability-rights 'eugenics/conditions of life' frames appear but may be under-weighted relative to government and DWDC spokespeople in expansion periods.
framing_hypotheses.falsifiable_by: Random sample N≥100 CBC.ca MAID articles 2020–2024 coded for primary voice category

framing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Mental-illness expansion delay coverage gives more platform to both sides (committee 2026) than Track-2 disability expansion peak did — temporal asymmetry testable.

sample_coding_schema_for_full_audit.outcome: counts + ratio disability_equality / compassion_autonomy by year
